## Checklist
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s console/tests` and `-s workflow/tests` pass
- [ ] `bash -n` on changed shell scripts
- [ ] Docs updated (area README, website/content/ja and en) if behaviour changed
- [ ] New design decision → new ADR in `docs/adr/` (existing ADRs are not edited)
- [ ] No secrets, hostnames, or private project data in the diff
